messages:
maria (growth): need a compact but differentiated benchmark narrative for launch that splits paths for devs vs finance. small hero + one explainer panel + savings calculator link. who can prototype the two-paths layout?
tejas (marketing): i'll map the messaging lanes. dev lane = latency-first (p50/p95 + KV cache warm/cold), finance lane = unit-econ waterfall + predictable runway calc.
olivia (design): idea: single hero with toggle (Dev | Finance). Dev shows latency bands + small throughput sparkline; Finance flips to waterfall + a projected monthly spend chart based on token play. Works on mobile as vertical stack.
samir (pm): data source: use last quarter v2-opt runs and dedicated quant profiles. i'll export a pared CSV with seq_len,p50,p95,cost_hosted,cost_ded_quant,cache_state and drop into /bench/launch/dual-path.csv.
kyle (data): sample rows for layout (placeholder):
```
seq_len,p50_ms,p95_ms,cost_hosted_1k,cost_ded_quant_1k,cache
128,42,120,0.020,0.0055,warm
512,85,240,0.020,0.0060,warm
1024,215,610,0.020,0.0075,cold
```
use for spacing and footnotes.
nina (content): CTA experiments: A) "Start free" (dev funnel) B) "Estimate savings" (finance funnel -> calculator form). copy options for Dev: "Low p50s, predictable tail behavior." For Finance: "Forecast your token spend and savings."
zara (growth_ops): routing rules: if calculator-estimate >$1500/mo OR estimated tokens >80k then create AE lead. if dev signup reaches >15k tokens in 7 days -> SDR outreach. add utm for partner referrals.
maria (growth): good. also capture fallback message: if dedicated capacity not available route to hosted variant and show a short note in the UI. samir pls flag compatibility tiers.
samir (pm): will add a small compatibility note and canned fallback copy. also include KV cache cold/warm as toggles in the explainer modal.
olivia (design): will mock toggle hero + mobile stack. need final header/copy by Wed noon. small ask: provide a micro testimonial (1 line) if legal can clear. boosts trust in finance lane.
kyle (data): sanity check numbers: headline should avoid absolute multipliers. we can use "up to 3x lower unit cost in dedicated configs" in a secondary callout with qualifier.
tejas (marketing): experiment plan: 2-week A/B test across channels. variants: toggle default = Dev vs default = Finance and CTA A vs B. metrics: CTR, signup conversion, token volume week1, AE handoffs. dashboard owner = tejas + kyle.
nina (content): will draft two short hero headers + three social captions and drop them in the doc by EOD. tone: clear, slightly technical, approachable.
zara (growth_ops): I'll codify routing rules and push hidden fields on the calculator form for estimated tokens and monthly spend.
maria (growth): timeline and owners summary: design Olivia, copy Nina, data Samir/Kyle, analytics Tejas, routing Zara, launch Maria. quick 15m sign-off Mon morning. thanks team :rocket:
